thread:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INCIDENT PD-78921 fired for service=runtime-inference-prod — alert=runtime-p99-latency-high, severity=P3, region=us-west-2 :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: paged rotation (primary: @alex, backup: @jordan). link: https://pd.example.com/PD-78921
alex: ack — I'm taking this. checking dashboards and traces now.
alex: quick prometheus check: `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="1.0"}[1m])) by (pool)` shows a short p99 bump around 14:03-14:05 UTC. magnitude ~600ms -> 1.1s for a small subset. no 5xx spike in logs.
maria: I see a correlated kv-cache coldstart spike in the same window — a bunch of nodes aged out and warmed again. probably warmup/kv eviction.
alex: running `kubectl get pods -l app=runtime-pool-west -o wide` and `kubectl top pods` to verify contention. also checking autoscaler logs.
alex: `kubectl logs runtime-pool-west-5f7d -c runtime | tail -n 200` shows repeated kv miss logging then normalizing. sample: ```[14:03:12] kv_cache: miss key=abc123; warmup_in_progress=true```
jordan: thanks — sounds like a warmup/cold start noise. any user-facing errors?
alex: quick check against nginx metrics: no 5xx increase, request rate stable. impact seems latency-only and confined to ~0.4% of traffic for a 90s window. likely not customer-facing degradations.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-78921 auto-resolved (duration ~3m). reason: alert threshold returned to normal.
maria: ok auto-resolved. still want to note this as noisy page — we get woken for a tiny fraction of traffic.
sre-lead: +1. file a tuning suggestion. can we suppress pages for p99 blips <2m and <0.5% of requests?
jordan: filing ticket TICKET-6543 to adjust alert policy and add a short suppress window for transient p99 spikes. assigning to alerting team.
alex: changed local mitigation: increased kv warmup parallelism on pool-west to smooth misses (applied as a quick hotfix). monitoring.
alex: handing off to @jordan for overnight watch — nothing else to do unless it reoccurs. :wave:
jordan: taking watch. will escalate if it returns. please add any relevant logs to the ticket.
sre-lead: thanks all — treat as noise for now but keep an eye for pattern. if we see >3 similar events in 24h, we'll open a deeper investigation. :mag:
alex: closing thread — PD auto-resolved, mitigation applied, ticket created TICKET-6543. :white_check_mark:
note: This thread records a short PagerDuty page that auto-resolved after transient kv-cache coldstart activity. Participants discussed checks, quick mitigation, and created a follow-up ticket.
